component.name: PollTask
component.script:
sub init() m.top.functionName = "poll" end sub
sub poll() http = CreateObject("roUrlTransfer") http.SetUrl(m.top.server + "/api/display") last = "" while true body = http.GetToString() if body <> "" and body <> last data = ParseJson(body) if data <> invalid m.top.state = data last = body end if end if sleep(3000) end while end sub
